Let me tell you a story of a writer ( his own writer )





I want my characters to have no bounds... Let there be boundaries to what they can do.. after all it's a imaginary world the world of fiction what a dream


People create fiction to come out of their own limited reality


Intro to H: He is the writer of xyz ( later on in the backstory the making of xyz will play a crucial role)
